parsed.why: No trans-specific criminalisation or border/facility bar; documented hate-crime prosecution gap and conservative climate, but state reopened cases and no trans-targeted policing. Domestic LGR gaps are not visitor exposure.

No criminalisation and courts struck surgery/toilet bans; but no hate-crime or anti-discrimination law, reported toilet/health abuse, dated severe airport abuse, and unclear enforcement leave recourse thin.

Decriminalised and no facility ban, but police dismiss trans violence via male-marker reasoning, health-care discrimination and impunity are documented; no protections or working recourse for an outed visitor.

Hostile national border/document regime (X stopped, mismatch refusals/fraud risk), facility bans in many states, custody abuse; courts and some protective states mitigate but do not offset universal border exposure.

Gender nonconformity itself criminal, with flogging/imprisonment/death available; documented cross-dressing arrests, custody death, deportation and airport arrest for expression. Tourism welcome offers no protection.
